target.text: On May 28, 2024, the U.S. securities market covered by the SEC amendments will move from T+2 to T+1 settlement.

materials.content:
SEC Final Rule 34-96930 | February 15, 2023
The Commission is adopting rule amendments to shorten the standard settlement cycle for most broker-dealer transactions from two business days after the trade date (T+2) to one business day after the trade date (T+1). The Commission is moving the compliance date to Tuesday, May 28, 2024.
materials.availability_basis: Official SEC final-rule PDF dated February 15, 2023; exact file bytes are evidenced by a July 30, 2023 archive snapshot recorded in sources.json.

materials.content:
U.S. SEC | Modernizing Equity Markets: Even the Leader Must Keep Training | October 21, 2024
On May 28, 2024, we achieved this. The equities, corporate bonds, and municipal markets successfully moved to T+1.
materials.availability_basis: Official SEC speech dated October 21, 2024; exact page bytes are evidenced by a November 7, 2024 archive snapshot recorded in sources.json.

target.text: The 2023 Atlantic hurricane season will finish with between 12 and 17 named storms, inclusive.

materials.content:
NOAA | 2023 Hurricane Season Outlook Hill Briefing | May 25, 2023
All ranges of activity are given with a 70% probability. Atlantic: Near-Normal Season; 12-17 Named Storms; 5-9 Hurricanes; 1-4 Major Hurricanes; 70%-145% Median ACE. Outlooks are for overall seasonal activity. They are not a hurricane landfall forecast.
materials.availability_basis: Dated static briefing PDF in NOAA's 2023-05 path; official Last-Modified, ETag, PDF metadata, and raw identity are recorded in sources.json.

materials.content:
NOAA Institutional Repository | The 2023 Atlantic Hurricane Season | September 2024
The 2023 Atlantic hurricane season was above normal, producing 20 named storms, 7 hurricanes, 3 major hurricanes, and seasonal accumulated cyclone energy that exceeded the 1991-2020 average.
materials.availability_basis: NOAA Institutional Repository record 67833, September 2024 issue; the paper was accepted July 8, 2024 and its PDF metadata and raw identity are recorded in sources.json.
